---
title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: "Javier Mercado"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "TX",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Median income") +
  labs(
    title = "Median household income by county, Texas (2020)",
    caption = "Source: ACS 5-year estimates via tidycensus"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_001", "B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE,
  summary_var = "B15003_001"
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    percent = 100 * sum(estimate[variable != "B15003_001"]) / unique(summary_est),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(NAME, percent), y = percent, fill = percent)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher by state-level geography (2020)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share of adults 25 and over",
    caption = "Source: ACS 5-year estimates via tidycensus"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(median_age = "B01002_001", population = "B01003_001"),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca |>
  select(-moe) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate) |>
  mutate(county = str_remove(NAME, " County, California")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = median_age, y = population)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    data = \(df) slice_max(df, population, n = 5),
    aes(label = county),
    vjust = -0.7,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    labels = scales::label_comma(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "County Population vs. Median Age, California (2020)",
    x = "Median age (years)",
    y = "Population (log scale)",
    caption = "Source: ACS 5-year estimates via tidycensus"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
